snippet.title: SMB: Unofficial PC Remake | MAR10th Teaser Video
snippet.description:
A special project that's been in the works for about a few months now.
Please wait for the official release of the game when it's complete.

SMB: Unofficial PC Port is not a port of SMB1 to the PC, but rather a recreation of the game made entirely in Construct 2. The title will be changed to reflect this once the game releases.

Thumbnail by Reinbotnik/Raviolichu (Me)

The Team that helped out on the project!:
Ultra_Inferno64 (Co-Lead + Sprite Artist)
Taiky93 (Coder + Sprite Artist)
daorangeboi (Sprite Artist)
Nathan Silver (Sprite Artist + Sound Designer)
2torial (Sprite Artist)
MetalicaLocura (Sprite Artist)
Lux-Boy (Musician)
Morgan Productions 2 (Musician)
willisaclown (Musician + Sound Designer)
VertederoGM (Level Designer + Sprite Artist)
IceLuigiFan (Concept Artist)
OscaRaczo (Beta Tester)
